meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: Claude 能操控浏览器完成网页任务:打开网址、读取页面结构、点击/填写表单、截图、提取文字和链接、保存登录状态等,并把结果反馈给你。
howto.when: 当需要查资料、读文章、填表单等时会触发;即使你没直接说“用浏览器”,只要任务适合用浏览器解决就会启动。

say.text: 帮我打开 example.com,把首页主要内容截图给我
say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器打开页面并截图返回

say.text: 查一下某产品的价格,提取页面上的标题和链接
say.note: Claude 会访问页面并提取文本和链接

say.text: 把这个表单填好并提交,然后告诉我结果
say.note: Claude 会用页面元素定位并填写提交

howto.what_en: Claude gains the ability to drive a browser: open pages, read page structure, click/fill forms, take screenshots, extract text and links, save auth state, and report results back.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task would benefit from a browser, such as researching, reading articles, or filling forms — even if the user has not explicitly asked to use one.

say_en.text: Open example.com and screenshot the homepage.
say_en.note: Claude opens the page and returns a screenshot.

say_en.text: Find a product price and extract the page title and links.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the page and pulls out text and links.

say_en.text: Fill in and submit this form, then tell me what happened.
say_en.note: Claude locates form elements, fills and submits, then reports the result.
